content.what_it_is: MATLAB Step-1 script of the FUNWAVE IG_waves example (header L1-L14, Fengyan Shi 04/06/2021): 'Read and generate frequency components of wind waves for IG generation and FUNWAVE for wind wave only'. Input: input_data_case1.txt @L17 (columns: frequency @L21, spectral density Ed @L22, and an IG reference spectrum in column 3 used for rows 1:100, L24-L25). Hardcoded depth=13.0 @L18 and peak_freq=0.158 @L19. Converts density to per-bin energy E(i)=Ed(i)*(f(i+1)-f(i)) (L27-L29); statistics E_total @L31, Hrms=sqrt(8*E_total) @L32, Hsig=Hrms*sqrt(2) @L33. Band-averages the spectrum: every sk=30 points @L37 up to trun=1601 @L38 ('T=3.4s truncated'): EE(count)=sum(E(ii:ii+sk-1)) @L42 with center frequency ff @L43; a final tail bin collects the remaining energy (L45-L46); recomputed stats Hrms1/Hsig1 (L50-L52) and Hsig_resolved=4*sqrt(sum(EE(2:end-1))) @L54. Component amplitudes Amp=sqrt(2.0.*EE(2:end-1)) @L56 at frequencies fff @L57. Plots data vs filtered spectrum vs IG reference (L60-L76, saved to plots/spc_input.jpg and .eps). Writes the four Step-2 input files (save -ASCII, L88-L91): SPC_dep_pf.txt (depth, peak_freq from otherp L85-L86), SPC_frq.txt (fff), SPC_angle.txt (angle_writeout=0 @L83), SPC_HMO.txt (hmo_writeout=Amp'*2.0*sqrt(2) @L84 — amplitude to Hmo). Also writes spectrum_windwave_only.txt (L95-L112) in the FUNWAVE spectrum-file layout: fprintf header 'NumFreq NumDir' @L106, PeakPeriod=1/peak_freq @L97/@L107, Freq lines @L108, Dire=0 @L109, then dlmwrite-appended amplitude row @L110 (no phase block).
entities: variables: hs @L17; depth @L18; peak_freq @L19; f @L21; Ed @L22; f_IG_data @L24; E_IG_data @L25; E @L28; E_total @L31; Hrms @L32; Hsig @L33; df @L35; sk @L37; trun @L38; count @L39; EE @L42/@L46; ff @L43/@L45; dff @L47; E_t @L50; Hrms1 @L51; Hsig1 @L52; Hsig_resolved @L54; Amp @L56; fff @L57; f_writeout @L82; angle_writeout @L83; hmo_writeout @L84; otherp @L85-L86; fname @L95; PeakPeriod @L97; NumFreq @L98; NumDir @L99; Freq @L100; Dire @L101; Amp1 @L102; fid @L105

equations.ref: Hrms from total energy; Hsig=Hrms*sqrt(2) @L33; band-averaged versions @L51-L52
30-point band averaging; ff(count)=f(ii+floor(sk/2)) @L43; tail bin EE(count+1)=sum(E(trun+sk:end)) @L46
header value for FUNWAVE spectrum file

calls: intrinsics/builtins only: load, sum, sqrt, floor, plot/clf/grid/hold/axis/xlabel/ylabel/legend/print (L60-L76), save, fopen/fprintf/dlmwrite/fclose

verbatim_spans.text: % Read and generate frequency components of wind waves for IG generation

unresolved: depth=13.0 @L18 and peak_freq=0.158 @L19 are hardcoded for case1 rather than derived from the loaded data — must be edited per case

The loop bound trun=1601 @L38 and tail index f(trun+floor(sk+sk/2)) @L45 assume input_data_case1.txt has enough rows (>1646); the last band-average window E(ii:ii+sk-1) @L42 with ii up to 1591 also requires length(E)>=1620 — no bounds checking

Amp uses EE(2:end-1) @L56 — the first and last (tail) bins are dropped from the written components (Hsig_resolved @L54 measures exactly what is kept); the energy in bin 1 and the tail bin is silently discarded from the FUNWAVE input
spectrum_windwave_only.txt is written without a phase block (only amplitudes @L110), unlike the two-component file written by IG_wave_generation.m — the downstream reader must supply random phases
The written frequency resolution is nonuniform at the tail (dff computed @L47 from the first two centers only); df @L35 'for equal increment' is used only for plotting normalization @L63
